{{Quote|Darth Nul took those who would follow her to an empty world in Wild Space where they could do is they pleased, without judgment. Nul taught her disciples how to forge mental bonds as she did. They called out to others and invited them to their sanctuary. But eventually, Nul made a connection with someone she did not intend. A being of dark malevolence... the Sith Emperor. He hunted her down, using her own power against her. Before the Emperor could reach her followers, Nul locked many of their secrets away, in the ruins my team discovered.|[[Sana-Rae]], to the [[Alliance Commander]]|<ref name="TOR:OW" />}}
Centuries before the [[Great Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR:DN">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=codex|Darth Nul}}</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Darth Nul|Raniah]] and her followers found refuge on an uninhabited '''planet''' in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] after their were expelled from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Unfortunately for them, they were soon discovered by the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] and were captured and enslaved by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. They eventually became servants of the Emperor and Raniah became Darth Nul.<ref name="TOR:OW" /> Centuries later,<ref name="TOR:DN" /> during the [[Third Galactic War]], the ruins of Raniah's camp were discovered by [[Sana-Rae]] and [[Arcann]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]], revealing the fate of Master Raniah and her followers.<ref name="TOR:OW" />
